response.query: What is the x402 payment protocol?
response.answer: x402 is an open HTTP payment protocol that uses the 402 Payment Required status code to negotiate and settle stablecoin transfers between a client and a server. It revives the long-reserved HTTP 402 “Payment Required” status code as a mechanism for websites, APIs, and AI agents to negotiate and settle micropayments in real time. Developed by the Coinbase Development Platform team, x402 enables any API or web service to require payment before serving content. It is an open, machine-native payment protocol that embeds cryptographic payments directly inside normal HTTP requests, allowing servers to signal payment requirements and clients to fulfill those requirements autonomously.
